rationale: The change is local to the write path of four services plus one new shared helper. The repo already contains a working precedent for the central technique (per-instance unique temp name) in two other services, so the design is not speculative. The existing node:test suite WorkspaceServiceFlushConcurrency.test.ts already demonstrates the fixture technique needed to make the race deterministic.
conditions: The Windows EPERM branch cannot be exercised natively on this Linux/WSL2 host; it is covered by fault injection at the fs boundary, which is weaker evidence than a native reproduction and is declared as such in the requirement text.
